service.description: jexl_busy_service: why tenant queries wait now (reconciliation runs queued or at their cap), or none.
jexl_owner_key_service: a deployment's lane key is its tenant, so one tenant's queries run one at a time.
jexl_owner_fields_service: a query or schedule is stored only for the caller's active tenant, which the caller must be an active member of.

parameter.name: ownerFields
parameter.description: The record's effective owner values (stored overlaid with given).

service.description: The "dataset" read source (darpan.query.DatasetQuerySource): input datasetId; a tenant's kept copy, only fields audits keep.

actions.script: Map out = darpan.query.DatasetQuerySource.read(ec, [input: input, ownerUserId: ownerUserId, userScriptId: userScriptId, ownerKey: ownerKey, runDate: runDate, timeZone: timeZone, maxRows: maxRows]) rows = out.rows; rowCount = out.rowCount; error = out.error

service.description: The "runResult" read source (darpan.query.RunResultQuerySource): input savedRunId; the newest result's differences.

actions.script: Map out = darpan.query.RunResultQuerySource.read(ec, [input: input, ownerUserId: ownerUserId, userScriptId: userScriptId, ownerKey: ownerKey, runDate: runDate, timeZone: timeZone, maxRows: maxRows]) rows = out.rows; rowCount = out.rowCount; error = out.error

service.description: The "auditFindings" read source (darpan.query.AuditFindingQuerySource): input auditId (and includeClosed); one row per finding with a fixed list of fields.

actions.script: Map out = darpan.query.AuditFindingQuerySource.read(ec, [input: input, ownerUserId: ownerUserId, userScriptId: userScriptId, ownerKey: ownerKey, runDate: runDate, timeZone: timeZone, maxRows: maxRows]) rows = out.rows; rowCount = out.rowCount; error = out.error

service.description: Delivery for scheduled queries (parameters: chatSpaceId): posts the summary, and which files went by email, to one of the tenant's chat spaces. Never files.

Delivery for scheduled queries (parameters: toAddresses, ccAddresses): emails the summary with the files as CSV (template DARPAN_QUERY_RESULT), and records each emailed file and its recipients in DataExportLog.

actions.script: Map out = darpan.query.QueryDelivery.email(ec, [scriptDeployment: scriptDeployment, delivery: delivery, scriptResult: scriptResult, files: files, scriptRunId: scriptRunId]) if (out.error) { ec.message.addError(out.error as String); return } outcome = out.outcome; message = out.message

service.description: jexl_owner_check_service: at every run, the schedule's owner must still be an active member and an admin of its tenant (scheduling sends the tenant's data out); otherwise moqui-jexl switches it off (OWNER_LOST).

One-time migration TENANT_SCRIPTS_TO_QUERIES (darpan.query.QueryMigration): the old tenant scripts become queries and their deployments chat-only schedules, switched off. Idempotent. Internal only, not remote.

actions.message: Migrated ${queries} scripts to queries and ${schedules} deployments to schedules (switched off); ${skipped} already done.
